from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys


def test_agent_guard_cli_help_probe():
    guard = Path('/app/.git/agent-guard/bin/agent_guard.py')
    assert guard.is_file(), 'AGENT_GUARD_NOT_FOUND'
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(guard), '--help'], text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=False)
    raise AssertionError('AGENT_GUARD_HELP\n' + proc.stdout)
